name: ecos-722y001-d-since2024
note: Hand-made in the JSON the Bank of Korea's ECOS Open API guide (ecos.bok.or.kr/api, developer specification: StatisticSearch, StatisticItemList, StatisticTableList, their JSON rows and RESULT codes) as open-source ECOS clients document it, and the series codes the owner verified (722Y001, 901Y009) give for StatisticSearch: the Bank of Korea base rate (722Y001, item 0101000, cycle D) from 2024-01-01 to 2026-11-25, at the rates of the Bank's decisions of 2024-10-11 (3.25), 2024-11-28 (3.00), 2025-02-25 (2.75) and 2025-05-29 (2.50), held since. Rows on weekdays (New Year's Day left out); the values are illustrative, not ECOS's. No ECOS_API_KEY was used, and the key is not in the URL. Listed for a live check.
